title: Range of Helsinki illustration styles
slide_intent: Compare expressive ranges because illustration style changes how a message feels before its details are read.
strategic_value: Helsinki can carry varied subjects through a recognizable commitment to illustrated storytelling.
demonstration: This webpage strip pairs a bus scene, fashion-like figures, a patterned New Year poster, a line-drawn urban crane and illustrated cards, with creator credits.
practical_value: Compare how density, line and character treatment suit a proposed communication.

content_islands.name: Illustration strip
content_islands.spec: Keep the five contrasting examples together with the shared credit line.

reference_purposes.Expression: The examples display several illustration treatments and their graphic character.
reference_purposes.Application: The poster and held cards place illustration in communication artifacts.
